name: Pixel Sort Databend
desc: Asendorf-style pixel sorting: a colourful synthesised field is databent by sorting contiguous brightness-threshold spans into melting glitch smears, the sort window drifting on the clock so the image perpetually re-melts — full-spectrum databend, VHS chroma-bleed, mono static, thermal, or channel-split chromatic.

density.doc: colour-band frequency of the source field (more = finer bands)

thresh.doc: sort coverage — how much of the frame melts into smears (wider brightness window)

energy.doc: exposure / contrast of the source field

speed.doc: field flow + sort-window drift + direction-flip rate

warp.doc: domain-warp turbulence of the source (also chroma-split width in vhs/chromatic)
